subject.title: Write tool lacks append mode — isolated cron sessions destroy shared files

question: Should OpenClaw accept `append?: boolean` on the existing write tool as the permanent ordinary-agent append contract, or require a different append API before closing this issue?
rationale: The failure is source-reproducible, but the remaining fix is a public model-facing and extension-observable tool contract rather than a purely internal bug repair.

options.title: Accept append on write
options.body: Land the open implementation after explicitly accepting `append?: boolean` as the supported write-tool append contract while preserving overwrite as the default.

options.title: Choose another append surface
options.body: Ask for a replacement shape such as `mode: "append"` or a dedicated append tool before merging any public API.

options.title: Defer the code change
options.body: Keep this issue open and rely on backup or shell-redirect workarounds, accepting that ordinary write calls can still truncate shared files.

recommendation.title: Accept append on write
recommendation.body: Land the open implementation after explicitly accepting `append?: boolean` as the supported write-tool append contract while preserving overwrite as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-agent runtime/tool-contract decision, and steipete is the strongest available routing signal from related maintainer discussion and repository guidance.
